content:
Priya Raman: quick async check — Acme pilot: they want BYOK + HSM-backed keys for Dedicated. Sales asked for confirmation on two items: 1) network path to HSM (customer expects TLS over specific CIDR) and 2) key import/signing flow (KMIP + rotation cadence). Also flagged PR #492 (network-config) for CR. Can eng confirm capability and blocker status?
Ben Cho: thanks — can you paste the exact CIDR they gave?
Priya Raman: they sent `10.240.8.0/22` and said traffic will originate from their peering vnet. quote: "must restrict key import to our gateway IPs".
Clara Voss: ok. Security will need an architecture sketch. @Ethan Harper can you confirm if our HSM provider supports KMIP import with IP allowlist?
Ethan Harper: yes, provider supports KMIP + BYOK import. two notes: 1) we need static egress IPs from Dedicated nodes (we already have an egress NAT plan but confirm with infra), 2) rotation can be automated but customer wants 30-day rotation window — fine but need policy doc. I'll take PR #492 for network pieces.
Priya Raman: lovely — Ben can you confirm whether peering will be setup tomorrow? customer expects handoff before EOD.
Ben Cho: they said "peering by EOD" but asked us to confirm a test window. i'll sync with customer ops now.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to `dedicated-us-west-2` for release branch `acme/onprem-kms` — window 2026-03-18 06:00 PT.
Clara Voss: for the security sketch i'll draft a one-pager: HSM topology, KMIP flow, IP allowlist, cert rotation. Priya — should I include SLA escape clauses?
Priya Raman: yes please — include fallback to hosted Redwood (without BYOK) as a contingency and note migration steps.
Ethan Harper: started review of PR #492. quick comment: need to add `SNAT` config for the NAT gateway so egress IPs are stable. posting a snippet:
```
# example nat config
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "dedicated" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat.id
  subnet_id     = var.public_subnet
}
```
Ben Cho: thanks — will ask customer to confirm test IPs and share a light test plan (SYN/ACK + KMIP handshake).
Priya Raman: action summary: Ethan -> PR + cert/rotation details; Ben -> confirm peering & test window; Clara -> security one-pager + SLA fallback. i'll update the deal doc and ping customer with tentative EOD peering ask. :thumbsup:
Clara Voss: noted, will post draft in sales drive and tag you for review.
Ben Cho: pinged customer, they proposed 14:00 PT test window. i'll update the doc.
Priya Raman: great. if anything blocks deploy/PR review call it out here. otherwise i'll close this thread after i update the SOW. thanks all. :pray:
